snippet.name: derived/height_ref_m
derived/thrust_abs
snippet.function: if invalid(value) then return nan end return abs(value)

snippet.name: derived/baro_aligned_m
snippet.function: if invalid(value) or invalid(v1) then return nan end if is_first then is_first = false offset = value - v1 end return value - offset

snippet.name: derived/baro_comp_k_t_m
snippet.global: nan = 0/0 function invalid(x) return x ~= x end function abs(x) return math.abs(x) end -- PX4 applies: corrected_alt = raw_alt + K_T * abs(thrust_z) -- Edit this value for the compensation gain you want to inspect. K_T = -1.0 is_first = true offset = 0
snippet.function: if invalid(value) or invalid(v1) or invalid(v2) then return nan end comp = value + K_T * abs(v1) if is_first then is_first = false offset = comp - v2 end return comp - offset

snippet.name: derived/raw_error_m
snippet.function: if invalid(value) or invalid(v1) then return nan end if is_first then is_first = false offset = value - v1 end return value - offset - v1

snippet.name: derived/comp_error_m
snippet.global: nan = 0/0 function invalid(x) return x ~= x end function abs(x) return math.abs(x) end -- PX4 applies: corrected_alt = raw_alt + K_T * abs(thrust_z) -- Edit this value for the compensation gain you want to inspect. K_T = -1.0 is_first = true offset = 0
snippet.function: if invalid(value) or invalid(v1) or invalid(v2) then return nan end comp = value + K_T * abs(v1) if is_first then is_first = false offset = comp - v2 end return comp - offset - v2

snippet.name: derived/baro_correction_m
snippet.function: if invalid(value) then return nan end return K_T * abs(value)

snippet.name: derived/motor_mean
snippet.function: if invalid(value) or invalid(v1) or invalid(v2) or invalid(v3) then return nan end return (value + v1 + v2 + v3) / 4.0

snippet.name: derived/motor_max
snippet.function: if invalid(value) or invalid(v1) or invalid(v2) or invalid(v3) then return nan end return math.max(value, v1, v2, v3)

snippet.name: derived/vxy_m_s
snippet.function: if invalid(value) or invalid(v1) then return nan end return math.sqrt(value * value + v1 * v1)

snippet.name: derived/accel_up_m_s2
snippet.function: if invalid(value) or invalid(v1) or invalid(v2) or invalid(v3) or invalid(v4) or invalid(v5) or invalid(v6) then return nan end ax = value ay = v1 az = v2 qw = v3 qx = v4 qy = v5 qz = v6 ned_z = (2 * (qx * qz - qw * qy)) * ax + (2 * (qy * qz + qw * qx)) * ay + (1 - 2 * (qx * qx + qy * qy)) * az return -(ned_z + 9.80665)

snippet.name: derived/esc_rpm_mean
snippet.function: if invalid(value) or invalid(v1) or invalid(v2) or invalid(v3) then return nan end return (value + v1 + v2 + v3) / 4.0
